captions.detailed: A slant-top casino slot machine cabinet with a dark reddish-brown body and a black base. It features an angled screen section with a gold banner plate above it, a projecting black button deck holding five colorful cylindrical push buttons (red, blue, green, yellow, white), and a black lower belly door equipped with a silver keyhole. The belly door is designed to hinge open on a vertical axis, while each of the five colorful buttons can depress independently as prismatic joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a slant-top casino slot machine. The model should include a main dark-red cabinet with an angled screen frame, a projecting black control deck with five colorful prismatic push buttons, and a lower black belly door that rotates on a vertical revolute joint with realistic motion limits.
captions.factory: The script constructs the slot machine by first defining various materials (dark red, black, gold, silver, and individual button colors). It builds the main cabinet body using a series of boolean cuts on a base box to create the sloped front and screen recess. The button deck, screen, and marquee banner are modeled as separate box geometries and positioned relative to the cabinet. Finally, the lower belly door is defined as a revolute joint rotating around a vertical Z-axis, and five cylindrical push buttons are instantiated as independent prismatic joints that move vertically.
